build_autoencoder_kl_cosmos: build a Cosmos video autoencoder KL model with configurable spatial and temporal compression ratios
encode_video_latents: encode a video tensor into compressed latent representations using the Cosmos encoder with patch embedding
decode_video_latents: decode compressed latent tensors back into video frames using the Cosmos decoder with unpatching
enable_tiled_decoding: enable tiled VAE decoding to process large video latents with configurable tile size and stride
review_causal_conv3d: review the CosmosCausalConv3d class for causal temporal padding and spatial convolution behavior
